description: DTO/entity/record enhancement in com.acme.loyalty.model: a JPA-style POJO (Member) with getters/setters/equals/hashCode/toString, a Java record with a compact constructor (PointsTransaction) and an enum with constructor, fields and a switch-based method (Tier). JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests include an assertNotNull-only test, @ParameterizedTest with @CsvSource (inline and multi-line array form), @EnumSource and a @Nested inner class. The JaCoCo report (single-line, as Maven writes it, with two sessioninfo entries) is exactly 100% on every counter; PointsTransaction has no branches so no BRANCH counter appears for it at any level.

quality.note: Only assertNotNull(member.toString()); toString can never return null here, so the format is not verified.

notes: strict100 is true: every counter at report, package, class, sourcefile and method level has missed="0".

PointsTransaction has no branches: no BRANCH counter on its class, its methods or PointsTransaction.java. The package and report BRANCH totals therefore come only from Member (8 branches) and Tier (8 branches).

Member.toString builds "Member{id=...}" - the braces are inside a string literal (source line 77). MemberTest.notEqualToOtherTypes passes the string "Member{id=1}". PointsTransaction Javadoc line 8 contains JSON braces and a semicolon.
MemberTest has 4 top-level tests and 5 tests in the @Nested class Equality (9 total). The @Nested class has @DisplayName("equals()") which contains parentheses.
TierTest @CsvSource is used both inline ({"B, BRONZE", ...}) and as a multi-line array; @ParameterizedTest(name = "code \"{0}\" -> {1}") contains escaped quotes and braces.

PointsTransaction declares its four accessors explicitly (with Javadoc and @Override, lines 33-55), so each accessor has its own line. The compiler-generated record toString/hashCode/equals sit on the header line 10 and are filtered by JaCoCo, so line 10 does not appear in the report. The // comment on line 31 is not code.
Enum values()/valueOf() and the synthetic $values() are filtered by JaCoCo; Tier <clinit> covers the constant lines 7-10 plus line 6 (the $VALUES assignment).
Member() is protected (not private), so JaCoCo does not filter it as an empty private constructor; it appears as <init> ()V on lines 15 and 17. The comment on line 16 is not executable.
